description: Find hardcoded user-visible text in JSX/TSX files and wrap it in a t tagged template so the compiler can extract it (what `verbaly wrap` does). This is how an existing codebase is onboarded, and verbaly_extract then adds the wrapped texts to the catalogs. It only reports unless write is set, and text already wrapped is skipped, so running it again is safe. Text it cannot wrap safely (a sentence split across markup, an expression rendering JSX) is listed as needing a human. A file that does not bind t is never written, because the rewrite would not compile. It comes back in blocked, with whether it is a client component, so you can add the binding and run again.

root.description: Project root holding verbaly.config (defaults to the server working directory)

write.description: Apply the rewrites instead of only reporting

name: verbaly_wrap

changed.description: Files the rewrite touched, or would touch

title: Wrap hardcoded JSX text
